title: Theft
description: Dishonest removal of movable property out of possession of any person without consent.
bailableCondition: Bailable as per First Schedule of BNSS / CrPC.

title: Theft in Dwelling House
description: Theft committed in any building, tent, or vessel used as a human dwelling or custody of property.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable. Judicial evaluation required.

title: Theft by Clerk or Servant of Property in Possession of Master
description: Theft committed by a clerk or servant of property belonging to master.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable.

title: Extortion
description: Intentionally putting any person in fear of injury to induce delivery of property or valuable security.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable. Discretionary bail based on investigation progress.

title: Robbery
description: Theft accompanied by causing or attempting death, hurt, or wrongful restraint.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable. Strict judicial scrutiny.

title: Dacoity
description: Robbery committed jointly by five or more persons.
bailableCondition: Heinous non-bailable offense. Stringent bail bar.

title: Robbery or Dacoity with Attempt to Cause Death or Grievous Hurt
description: Using deadly weapon or causing grievous hurt while committing robbery or dacoity.
bailableCondition: Heinous non-bailable offense carrying 7 years minimum sentence.

title: Criminal Breach of Trust
description: Dishonest misappropriation or conversion of property entrusted to accused.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable, but compoundable with court permission.

title: Criminal Breach of Trust by Public Servant or Banker
description: Breach of trust committed by a public servant, banker, merchant, factor, broker, attorney, or agent.
bailableCondition: Heinous non-bailable offense carrying up to life imprisonment.

title: Punishment for Cheating (Simple)
description: Cheating any person without property delivery inducement.
bailableCondition: Bailable as a matter of right.

title: Cheating & Dishonest Inducement of Property
description: Cheating and thereby dishonestly inducing person deceived to deliver property or alter valuable security.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable, eligible for BNSS 479 half-time or 1/3rd term relief.

title: Mischief Causing Damage to Amount of Fifty Rupees
description: Committing mischief causing loss or damage to property.
bailableCondition: Bailable as a matter of right.

title: Punishment for Forgery
description: Making false document or false electronic record with intent to cause damage or injury.
bailableCondition: Bailable offense.

title: Forgery of Valuable Security or Will
description: Forging a document purporting to be a valuable security, will, or authority to transfer property.
bailableCondition: Heinous non-bailable offense carrying up to life imprisonment.

title: Forgery for Purpose of Cheating
description: Making false documents or electronic records intending it to be used for cheating.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable. Forensic document report required.

title: Using as Genuine a Forged Document
description: Fraudulently or dishonestly using as genuine any document known to be forged.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable. Punishment matches forgery section.

title: Criminal Conspiracy
description: Party to a criminal conspiracy to commit an offense punishable with death, life, or rigorous imprisonment.
bailableCondition: Punishment matches the primary offense conspired to be committed.

title: Murder
description: Intentionally causing death of a human being.
bailableCondition: Heinous offense carrying life sentence or death penalty.

title: Culpable Homicide Not Amounting to Murder
description: Causing death with intention or knowledge but without murder premeditation.
bailableCondition: Heinous non-bailable offense.
keyElements: Bodily injury likely to cause death

title: Dowry Death
description: Death of a woman caused by burns or bodily injury occurring within 7 years of marriage under dowry harassment.
specialActDetails: IPC 304B / BNS 80 carrying minimum 7 years up to life imprisonment.
bailableCondition: Heinous non-bailable offense. Statutory presumption under Evidence Act.

title: Abetment of Suicide
description: Abetting any person to commit suicide.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable. Evaluation of suicide note & overt instigation.

title: Attempt to Murder
description: Doing any act with intention or knowledge that if death was caused, defendant would be guilty of murder.
bailableCondition: Heinous non-bailable offense.

title: Attempt to Commit Culpable Homicide
description: Doing an act with intention or knowledge to cause culpable homicide not amounting to murder.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable offense.

title: Voluntarily Causing Hurt
description: Causing bodily pain, disease or infirmity to any person.
bailableCondition: Bailable as a matter of right under BNSS Section 480 / CrPC Section 436.

title: Voluntarily Causing Hurt by Dangerous Weapons
description: Causing hurt by means of any instrument for shooting, stabbing or cutting, or by fire/poison.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable. Weapon recovery report required.

title: Voluntarily Causing Grievous Hurt
description: Causing severe bodily injury like fractures, loss of sight, or permanent disfiguration.
bailableCondition: Bailable under magistrate discretion; compoundable with court permission.

title: Voluntarily Causing Grievous Hurt by Dangerous Weapons
description: Causing grievous hurt by instruments of shooting, stabbing, cutting, or corrosive substances.
bailableCondition: Heinous non-bailable offense carrying up to life imprisonment.

title: Voluntarily Causing Hurt by Use of Acid
description: Throwing acid or administering corrosive substance causing permanent or partial damage, deformity, or disfigurement.
bailableCondition: Heinous non-bailable offense carrying minimum 10 years up to life imprisonment.

title: Assault or Criminal Force to Deter Public Servant from Duty
description: Assaulting or using criminal force to any person being a public servant in execution of duty.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable under BNSS 2023.

title: Assault to Woman with Intent to Outrage Modesty
description: Assaulting or using criminal force on any woman intending to outrage or knowing it likely to outrage her modesty.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable. Judicial scrutiny on gravity.

title: Sexual Harassment of Woman
description: Unwelcome physical contact, demand for sexual favors, showing pornography, or making sexually colored remarks.
bailableCondition: Bailable for clauses (i)-(iii); bailable as a right.

title: Assault to Disrobe Woman
description: Assaulting or using criminal force to any woman with intent to disrobe or compel her to be naked.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable offense.

title: Voyeurism
description: Watching or capturing the image of a woman engaging in a private act without her consent.
bailableCondition: Bailable on first conviction; non-bailable on repeat offense.

title: Stalking
description: Following a woman and contacting her despite clear indication of disinterest, or monitoring digital use.
bailableCondition: Bailable on first conviction.

title: Trafficking of Persons
description: Recruiting, transporting, harboring, transferring, or receiving a person for exploitation using threat, force, or coercion.
specialActDetails: BNS 2023 Section 143 / IPC Section 370.
bailableCondition: Heinous non-bailable offense carrying 7 to 10 years minimum sentence.

title: Rape
description: Sexual assault committed on a woman without her consent or against her will.
specialActDetails: BNS 2023 Section 64 carrying minimum 10 years up to life imprisonment.
bailableCondition: Heinous non-bailable offense. Strict judicial bar.

title: Gang Rape
description: Rape committed by one or more persons acting in furtherance of common intention.
specialActDetails: BNS 2023 Section 70(1) carrying minimum 20 years to life imprisonment.
bailableCondition: Strict non-bailable bar.

title: Husband or Relative Subjecting Woman to Cruelty
description: Subjecting a married woman to physical or mental cruelty, or harassment for unlawful dowry demands.
bailableCondition: Governed by Arnesh Kumar SC guidelines (mandatory Section 35 BNSS notice prior to arrest).

title: Defamation
description: Making or publishing any imputation concerning any person intending to harm reputation.
bailableCondition: Bailable as a matter of right.

title: Penetrative Sexual Assault on Minor
description: Penetrative sexual assault committed on a child under POCSO Act 2012.
specialActDetails: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act 2012 Section 4. Presumption of guilt under Sec 29.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable Special Act. Presumption of culpable mental state against accused.

title: Aggravated Penetrative Sexual Assault on Minor
description: Aggravated penetrative sexual assault on a minor committed by person in position of trust or authority.
specialActDetails: POCSO Section 6 carrying minimum 20 years to life imprisonment.
bailableCondition: Strict non-bailable statutory bar.

title: Sexual Assault on Minor
description: Committing sexual assault on a child without penetration.
specialActDetails: POCSO Act Section 8.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable Special Act.

title: Aggravated Sexual Assault on Minor
description: Committing aggravated sexual assault on a child without penetration.
specialActDetails: POCSO Act Section 10.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable Special Act.

title: Sexual Harassment of Minor
description: Uttering words, making gestures, or exhibiting body parts to harass a child sexually.
specialActDetails: POCSO Act Section 12.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable Special Act.

title: Using Child for PORNOGRAPHIC Purposes
description: Using a child for media or digital pornographic representation.
specialActDetails: POCSO Act Section 14.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable Special Act.

title: Intentionally Insulting SC/ST Member in Public View
description: Intentionally insulting or humiliating a member of SC or ST community in any place within public view.
specialActDetails: Scheduled Castes & Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act 1989. Sec 18 bars anticipatory bail.
bailableCondition: Regular bail under court evaluation. Section 18 bars anticipatory bail.

title: Abusing SC/ST Member by Caste Name in Public
description: Abusing any member of a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe by caste name in public view.
specialActDetails: SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act Section 3(1)(s).
bailableCondition: Regular bail subject to Section 18 bar examination.

title: Committing IPC Offense Penalized 10+ Yrs Against SC/ST
description: Committing any offense under IPC punishable with 10 years or more against a person or property of SC/ST member.
specialActDetails: SC/ST Act Section 3(2)(v) carrying enhanced life imprisonment.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable Special Act. Strict statutory scrutiny.

title: Penalty for Damage to Computer System
description: Accessing, downloading, or introducing virus to computer system without authorization.
specialActDetails: IT Act Section 43.
bailableCondition: Bailable offense.

title: Computer Related Acts & Hacking
description: Dishonestly or fraudulently committing any act referred to in Section 43 of IT Act.
specialActDetails: Information Technology Act 2000 Section 66.
bailableCondition: Bailable offense.

title: Identity Theft & Digital Credentials Misuse
description: Fraudulently making use of electronic signature, password or unique identification feature.
specialActDetails: Information Technology Act Section 66C.
bailableCondition: Bailable offense.

title: Cheating by Personation using Computer Resource
description: Punishment for cheating by personation by using computer resource or communication device.
specialActDetails: Information Technology Act 2000 Section 66D Cyber Fraud.
bailableCondition: Bailable under IT Act provisions.

title: Penalty for Breach of Confidentiality and Privacy
description: Securing access to electronic record and disclosing confidentiality without consent.
specialActDetails: IT Act Section 72.
bailableCondition: Bailable offense.

title: Offense of Money Laundering
description: Direct or indirect involvement in process or activity connected with proceeds of crime.
specialActDetails: Prevention of Money Laundering Act 2002. Section 45 twin conditions apply.
bailableCondition: Section 45 PMLA twin conditions apply; exception for sick, infirm, or women.

title: Offense Relating to Public Servant Being Bribed
description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain undue advantage by a public servant.
specialActDetails: PC Act Section 7 as amended in 2018.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable Special Act. Special Judge court jurisdiction.

title: Criminal Misconduct by a Public Servant
description: Intentionally enriching oneself illicitly during period of office.
specialActDetails: PC Act Section 13 Disproportionate Assets.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable Special Act carrying up to 10 years imprisonment.

title: Acts Endangering Sovereignty & Integrity of India
description: Purposely or knowingly exciting secession, armed rebellion, or subversive activities endangering sovereignty of India.
specialActDetails: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023 Section 152 - National Security.
bailableCondition: Heinous non-bailable offense. Scrutiny by High Court / Sessions Judge.

title: Unlawful Activities & Association
description: Taking part in or committing unlawful activities supporting secession or disaffection against India.
specialActDetails: Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act 1967 Section 13. Sec 43D(5) stringent bar.
bailableCondition: Stringent bail conditions under UAPA Sec 43D(5). Court must examine case diary.

title: Conspiracy for Terrorist Act
description: Conspiring, attempting, advocating, or inciting the commission of a terrorist act.
specialActDetails: UAPA Section 18 carrying minimum 5 years to life imprisonment.
bailableCondition: Strict statutory bar under UAPA Section 43D(5). Prima facie test.

title: Trafficking of Cannabis (Commercial Quantity)
description: Possession, sale, or transportation of commercial quantity of narcotic substances.
specialActDetails: Narcotic Drugs & Psychotropic Substances Act Section 37 twin conditions apply.
bailableCondition: Section 37 NDPS requires court satisfaction that accused is not guilty.

title: Financing Illicit Drug Traffic & Harboring Offenders
description: Directly or indirectly financing illicit drug trafficking or harboring persons engaged in drug trade.
specialActDetails: NDPS Section 27A carrying 10 to 20 years imprisonment.
bailableCondition: Strict Section 37 twin statutory conditions apply.

title: Illegal Possession of Unlicensed Firearms or Ammunition
description: Manufacturing, possessing, or carrying prohibited arms or ammunition without valid license.
specialActDetails: Arms Act 1959 Section 25.
bailableCondition: Non-bailable Special Act. Ballistic verification mandatory.

title: Cruelty or Assault to Juvenile / Child
description: Assaulting, abandoning, abusing, or exposing a child causing mental or physical suffering.
specialActDetails: JJ Act 2015 Section 75.
bailableCondition: Bailable offense under JJ Board jurisdiction.

title: Overstaying or Illegal Entry by Foreign National
description: Remaining in India beyond valid visa duration or entering without valid passport/travel documents.
specialActDetails: Foreigners Act 1946 / Passport Act 1920. Flight risk & embassy notification mandatory.
bailableCondition: High flight risk. Requires embassy intimation, passport surrender, and deportation clearance.
